method.name: OpenMM fixed-coordinate cross-chain Nonbonded interface energy proxy

primary_paper.title: OpenMM 7: Rapid development of high performance algorithms for molecular dynamics

protocol.coordinates: fixed generator PDB after pdb2pqr protonation

protonation.notes: --neutralc incompatible with AMBER in pdb2pqr30; ARTIFICIAL_FV_C_TERMINUS_LIMITATION recorded

interface_definition.rule: residue is interface if any heavy atom is within cutoff of any heavy atom on the other chain

energy.scope: sum NonbondedForce Coulomb+LJ over atom pairs with i in H-interface and j in L-interface only
energy.interpretation: RELATIVE STATIC PROXY — not experimentally calibrated absolute energies

geometry_artifact_rule: If |Spearman(E_vdw_interface, severe_clash_count)| >= 0.5 on target-blind Dev+Test pooled per generator, record GEOMETRY_ARTIFACT_CONCERN
feasibility_block: If consistent parameterization/protonation fails across generators => METHOD_BLOCKED (do not substitute contact counts as INTERFACE-ENERGY)
anti_posthoc: Do not retune FF/cutoff/components after targets; any change => INTERFACE-ENERGY_v2_POSTHOC
